h1: Product feeds for Google Shopping and marketplaces
overview: A feed is only as good as the data in it. We review your products against what Google Merchant Center and your chosen marketplace expect, fix missing titles, identifiers, categories and image problems, and build a feed that follows each channel's rules. We connect it to your account, run the first check and clear the errors we can see. Approval is decided by the channel, not by us.

pkgs.blurb: One clean feed for one channel, with common errors fixed.
Feed rules and fixes for two channels, with a better title format.
A full feed setup with rules, custom labels and a health checklist.

faq: Google Merchant Center is the most common. We also prepare feeds for Meta catalogs, Bing, Pinterest and marketplaces that accept product feeds. Tell us the channel in the order form and we check its current rules.

Approval is decided by each channel, so we cannot promise it. We fix what we can see against their published rules, and we tell you about issues, such as restricted products, that only you can resolve.
Do I need a Merchant Center account?
Yes, in your own name. You create it or we guide you, then add us as a user. We never take over your account. Any ad spend or marketplace fees are billed to you by the channel.
What if my products have no barcodes?
Some channels ask for GTIN codes, brands or MPNs. If you have them, send them. For handmade or custom items we use the channel's option for products with no identifier, where it allows that.
